_comment: Calibrated SF=1 uncompressed source-data sizes in bytes. The reference method for every entry is the generator volume gate's own `benchbox run` path (docs/internal/generator-volume-gate.md); scripts/measure_sf1_sizes.py measures write_primitives and transaction_primitives at 1572187172 instead of the gate-path 1572580199. Four entries (tsbs_devops, joinorder_synthetic, write_primitives, transaction_primitives) were re-measured through that gate path on 2026-11-22; the others were measured with scripts/measure_sf1_sizes.py on 2026-09-26. Regenerate with: uv run -- python scripts/measure_sf1_sizes.py --output /tmp/sf1.json, then copy each record's total_bytes here and update https://benchbox.dev/docs/benchmarks/sf1-calibrated-sizes.html in the same commit.
